core.title: Simple Aluminum Cabinet Pull Omnia AL409

text.description_html:
Omnia AL409 Sleek Simple Aluminum Cabinet Hardware

Aluminum (US28) finished, these sleek cabinet pulls are a great way to add a contemporary touch to your home. Aluminum is durable, lightweight, and easy to clean, ensuring that this Omnia made cabinet hardware will last for years to come and look beautiful while doing it. Available in 5 inch, 7-1/2 inch, or 12-1/2 inch lengths, you will be sure to find just the right fit for your needs.

Omnia's line of sophisticated Aluminum cabinet hardware have been painstakingly crafted by artisans who understand that a beautiful design must be as comfortable to the hand as it is pleasing to the eyes.

Available in 3 Sizes:

  • OMN-AL409/127 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 5", Overall Length: 5-1/2", Projection: 1-7/16"
  • OMN-AL409/190 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 7-1/2", Overall Length: 8", Projection: 1-7/16"
  • OMN-AL409/318 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 12-1/2", Overall Length: 12-5/8", Projection: 1-7/16"
